question: Who among the following teamed up with flautist Hariprasad Chaurasia and guitarist Brij Bhushan Kabra and produced a concept album, ‘Call of the Valley’ (1967)?
solution:
The correct answer is **Shivkumar Sharma.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Pandit Shivkumar Sharma (13 January 1938 – 10 May 2022) was an Indian classical musician and santoor player who is credited with adapting the santoor for Indian classical music.
 
• As a** music composer**, he collaborated with** Indian flautist Hariprasad Chaurasia** under the **collaborative name Shiv–Hari **and composed music for many Indian films.
 
• He was awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1986**, the **Padma Shri**, India's **fourth-highest civilian award in 1991**, and the **Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award in 2001.**
 
• He is credited with introducing the santoor as a **popular Indian classical music instrument**.
 
• He co-produced a concept album, Call of the Valley (1967), 1967 with** flautist Hariprasad Chaurasia** and **guitarist Brij Bhushan Kabra.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Tarun Bhattacharya:

 
• He is an** Indian classical musician** who plays the **santoor**, a type of **hammered dulcimer.**
 
• He studied with **Ravi Shankar.**

Bhajan Sopori:

 
• He is an **Indian instrumentalist.**
 
• He is a player of the **santoor**, an **ancient stringed musical instrument.**
 
• On the occasion of the **67th Indian Republic Day 2016, Pandit Bhajan Sopori **was accorded **Jammu and Kashmir State lifetime achievement award.**

**Satish Vyas:**

 
• He is an Indian Santoor player.
 
• He is the son of Indian classical singer CR Vyas. 
 
• He has been awarded the Tansen Award on 26 December 2020.
